findings.highlight: my tension disappeared
findings.evidenceJa: 緊張の糸が切れた
findings.governingReading: The strain holding Shirou together snaps after Rin leaves.
findings.explanation: The stock image of a taut thread breaking is reduced to tension simply vanishing, weakening the causal and bodily release.

findings.highlight: it should have more than enough value for any magus. magus to want it.
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師としては十分すぎる程価値のある物だ
findings.governingReading: The Grail has more than enough value to a magus even if it cannot literally grant every wish.
findings.explanation: A duplicated fragment leaves the sentence grammatically damaged.

findings.highlight: accepting that easy way to reach a goal feels like cheating myself
findings.evidenceJa: そんな近道はなんか卑怯だと思うのだ
findings.governingReading: Shirou feels that taking such a shortcut is somehow cowardly or unfair.
findings.explanation: The English invents self-cheating and turns his moral aversion to shortcuts into a claim about personal authenticity.

findings.highlight: No matter what your expectations are, as long as you enter it, you can’t survive unless you defeat your enemies.
findings.evidenceJa: どのような思惑だろうと、参加したからには相手を押し退けないと生き残れない
findings.governingReading: Whatever a participant’s designs or motives, entering obliges them to push rivals aside to survive.
findings.explanation: Motives become expectations, and the chair-game image of displacing rivals is narrowed into defeating enemies.

findings.highlight: I get up.
findings.evidenceJa: 横になっていた体を起こす
findings.governingReading: Shirou raises his body from where he was lying.
findings.explanation: The English can indicate standing, losing the explicitly staged transition from lying down to sitting up.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka didn’t say the most important thing
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂のヤツ、肝心なコトは外しやがって
findings.governingReading: Shirou angrily complains that Rin skipped the crucial point.
findings.explanation: The factual paraphrase removes the rough, accusatory force of his outburst.

findings.highlight: but I can’t do that
findings.evidenceJa: 生憎俺にはそんな芸当はさせられない
findings.governingReading: Unfortunately Shirou cannot make Saber assume spirit form.
findings.explanation: The English leaves the act and its target unstated, obscuring the Master’s causative role in Servant spiritualization.

findings.highlight: just how am I a Master?
findings.evidenceJa: 俺のどこがアイツのマスターだって言うんだ
findings.governingReading: Shirou asks in what sense he can be her Master.
findings.explanation: Dropping her weakens the relationship-specific doubt into a generic question about his title.

findings.highlight: Even if you give a guy that has only used old guns a brand new weapon, he won’t know how to use it
findings.evidenceJa: それでも幸いなのは、この戦車にはオートパイロット機能がついている事か
findings.governingReading: Shirou continues the new recruit and tank analogy directly: fortunately the tank has an autopilot.
findings.explanation: The translation inserts an unsupported old-guns/new-weapon analogy and an extra narration beat.

findings.highlight: I hit my head against the wall
findings.evidenceJa: 柱に頭を打ち付けた
findings.governingReading: Shirou physically knocks his head against a pillar.
findings.explanation: The concrete object in the comic action is changed from a pillar to a wall.

findings.highlight: That was such an impolite complaint.
findings.evidenceJa: とんでもなく失礼な弱音だった
findings.governingReading: Shirou condemns the thought as an appallingly disrespectful show of weakness.
findings.explanation: Complaint drops the self-accusation of weakness that motivates his immediate resolve to find Saber.

findings.highlight: She is sitting there naturally.
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女は、ただ自然にそこにいた
findings.governingReading: She is simply and naturally there in the dojo.
findings.explanation: The English supplies a sitting posture before the active text establishes one.

findings.highlight: I can see nothing amiss in her dignified posture.
findings.evidenceJa: 凛と正された姿勢からは、わずかな乱れも感じられない
findings.governingReading: The confirmed active Japanese ends after sunlight makes Saber and the dojo one; the posture sentence is inactive source material.
findings.explanation: mirror moon activates a removed sentence, changing the content and pacing of the current witness.

findings.highlight: the girl that mercilessly slashed him with her sword
findings.evidenceJa: ためらう事なく剣を振るった少女
findings.governingReading: Saber swung her sword without hesitation when she appeared under the moon.
findings.explanation: Decisiveness becomes mercilessness, imposing a harsher moral judgment on Saber.

findings.highlight: I have completely accepted Saber
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーという少女の全てを認めてしまっていた
findings.governingReading: In that instant Shirou finds himself accepting the whole of the girl called Saber.
findings.explanation: The English drops the girl framing and the scope of all of her, flattening a relational recognition into generic acceptance.

findings.highlight: is surprisingly suited to this place
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女の声は、この道場にあっている
findings.governingReading: Her permeating voice suits the dojo.
findings.explanation: Surprisingly adds an unsupported judgment about Shirou’s expectations.

findings.highlight: YYeah. I just got up.
findings.evidenceJa: あああ。ついさっき、目が覚めた
findings.governingReading: Shirou flusters through an elongated or repeated affirmation before saying he just woke.
findings.explanation: The opening is corrupted into the typographical form YYeah.

findings.highlight: The golden-haired girl approaches me.
findings.evidenceJa: シロウ？　顔色が優れないようですが、やはり体調は悪いのですか？
findings.governingReading: Saber asks whether Shirou is ill because he looks pale.
findings.explanation: The English inserts an approach action absent from the active Japanese staging.

findings.highlight: Perhaps her armor looked so surreal that I didn’t notice yesterday. But if she dresses like a girl, as a healthy guy, I’m troubled.
findings.evidenceJa: 鎧姿、という出で立ちがあまりにも非現実的だったので、昨夜はそう気にならなかったのだろう
findings.governingReading: The confirmed Japanese page is empty; this attraction explanation survives only as inactive source material.
findings.explanation: mirror moon activates removed internal narration and changes the current scene’s pacing and characterization.

findings.highlight: This will be the first time we sit down and talk
findings.evidenceJa: こうやって落ち着いて話すのは初めてだけど
findings.governingReading: Shirou says this is their first chance to talk calmly like this.
findings.explanation: The translation invents the physical act of sitting down.

findings.highlight: Whadon’t be stupid.
findings.evidenceJa: なバカ言ってんな
findings.governingReading: Shirou blurts out a broken-off objection followed by “don’t be stupid.”
findings.explanation: A spacing or assembly failure fuses the opening into Whadon’t.

findings.highlight: Andif she is really taking part in this war.
findings.evidenceJa: 本当にこの戦いに参加するのかということを
findings.governingReading: Shirou needs to establish whether she truly intends to participate in the war.
findings.explanation: A missing space fuses And and if, while the surrounding sentence remains fragmentary.

findings.highlight: There’s no room for me to question her about it.
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女の意思には疑問を挟む余地などない
findings.governingReading: Saber’s resolve leaves no room for doubt.
findings.explanation: The English makes Shirou refrain from questioning her rather than presenting her will as indubitable.

findings.highlight: I’ve already convinced myself that I have to fight.
findings.evidenceJa: どのみち戦うしかないって覚悟はしたんだ
findings.governingReading: Shirou has steeled himself to the fact that he must fight.
findings.explanation: Convinced myself suggests rationalization rather than a deliberate hardening of resolve.

findings.highlight: Even though I’m weak, making Saber fight,
findings.evidenceJa: つまらない弱音を殺す
findings.governingReading: Shirou kills or suppresses the petty weakness arising within him.
findings.explanation: The English turns an inward act of suppressing fear and weakness into stopping overt whining.

findings.highlight: tomorrow might end up like today
findings.evidenceJa: 明日にでも昨日みたいな事になりかねない
findings.governingReading: As soon as tomorrow, events could repeat what happened yesterday.
findings.explanation: The comparison point shifts from yesterday’s battle to today.

findings.highlight: Even though I’m weak, making Saber fight, And I can’t stand letting a scene like that happen again.
findings.evidenceJa: 私は私が許す行為しか出来ない
findings.governingReading: Shirou cannot bear making Saber fight because of his weakness and causing that sight to recur.
findings.explanation: The sentence breaks at And, obscuring the causal chain that joins his inadequacy, her fighting, and repeated injury.

findings.highlight: For example, attacking people to gain pow
findings.evidenceJa: たとえば、力を得る為に人を襲うと、か
findings.governingReading: Shirou tests whether “every possible means” includes attacking people to gain power.
findings.explanation: The final word is truncated and the ethical test is left visibly incomplete.

findings.highlight: that is not a possibility. I can only do those things I will allow myself to do.
findings.evidenceJa: それは可能である手段ではありません。私は私が許す行為しか出来ない
findings.governingReading: Attacking civilians is not among the means available to Saber because she can act only within what she morally permits herself.
findings.explanation: Not a possibility can imply external or physical impossibility, blurring the self-imposed ethical boundary defined immediately afterward.

findings.highlight: you will have to use one of your Command Spells to compensate for treading inside me
findings.evidenceJa: 私に踏みいる代償として、その刻印を一つ頂く事になります
findings.governingReading: For forcing entry into Saber’s inner will, the Master must pay one Command Spell.
findings.explanation: Treading inside me is non-English and obscures the violation of her will that explains the Command Spell cost.

findings.highlight: Her lack of doubt gave her the image of a cold fighting machine
findings.evidenceJa: あまりの強さと迷いのなさに戦闘機械のようなイメージがあった
findings.governingReading: Saber’s overwhelming strength and unhesitating certainty had made her seem like a fighting machine.
findings.explanation: The English drops her strength and adds cold, changing the basis and tone of Shirou’s mistaken image.

findings.highlight: until you become a suitable Master
findings.evidenceJa: シロウがマスターとして成熟するまで
findings.governingReading: Until Shirou matures as a Master, Rin can teach him.
findings.explanation: Maturation is developmental; suitable recasts the endpoint as basic acceptability and sharpens Saber’s judgment of him.
